title: 12 Revenue Leakage Examples (SaaS, Ecommerce, Agency & Service)
description: Concrete revenue leakage examples with estimated impact — trial conversion, cart abandonment, proposal ghosting, failed payments, and more.

faq.q: What is an example of revenue leakage?
faq.a: A SaaS company with 500 trials/month converting at 4% instead of 12% — at $150 ARPU that is thousands per month left uncaptured.

faq.q: What is the most common revenue leak?
faq.a: It varies by model: SaaS often leaks in conversion and billing; ecommerce in cart abandonment; agencies in follow-up and scope creep.

blocks.text: These revenue leakage examples are patterns we see across niches — often two or three active at once. Use them to spot what sounds familiar, then quantify with your own numbers.

items: Trial-to-paid below benchmark with healthy top-of-funnel
8% monthly churn with no exit survey or save offer
Failed card charges with no dunning sequence
Single-plan customers never shown upgrade path
One-time buyers with no second-purchase campaign
Proposals sent, never followed up within 48 hours
No-show appointments without reminders or deposits
Invoices sent weeks after work completed
